name: Scopa
summary: Italian fishing card game where players capture table cards by matching ranks or sums to earn 11 points.
rules_text: Scopa uses 40 cards in 4 suits. Players need even numbers; with 4+ they form pairs sitting opposite. Dealer gives 3 cards to each player and 4 face up to table, deck aside. On your turn play one card from hand. If a table card has same rank, you must take that pair. If not, you may take any set of table cards whose ranks sum to your card's rank, but a single equal rank takes precedence. If no capture is possible you add your card to the table. A capture that clears the whole table is a Scopa and scores 1. When all hands are empty deal 3 more cards each until deck is gone; the last player to capture takes any leftover table cards. Scoring per round: 1 for each Scopa, 1 for most cards captured, 1 for most Coins, 1 for the Seven of Coins, 1 for best Primera - sum of highest Primera value in each suit from your pile. Ties give no point. Teams pool captures. First to 11 wins.
rating_reason: Classic Italian capturing card game, turn-based hidden hands
